sources.researchNote: The label image accompanying the upload reads “Best.-Nr. 3098”, not “78 N”, and names Bernard Etté und sein Orchester and refrain singer Kurt Mühlhardt. SRC0758 shows the other title on the same catalogue issue, also numbered 3098; this does not establish that the transfers came from the same physical copy. “Aufnahme 1930” is the uploader’s recording-year statement, not an independently established issue date. SRC0471 documents the composition’s copyright registration, not the disc or its publisher; the record label does not name Alrobi.
